answer: The grove cap is enforced at intake and forge shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a gale tag. That is 37 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
